zh-CN.title: 桌面媒体预览操作优化
items: 桌面媒体预览可用两侧按钮、方向键或触控板左右切换，信息与沉浸查看可直接点击。
照片支持滚轮或双击缩放，放大后可拖动查看。编辑裁剪范围时也可以用滚轮。

en.title: Desktop media viewer controls
items: Browse media with the side buttons, arrow keys, or a trackpad swipe. Open media details and immersive view from the toolbar.
Zoom photos with the mouse wheel or a double-click, then drag to pan. The mouse wheel also adjusts the crop in the photo editor.
